coverage: Reported business segments · gross segment income
incomeDefinition: Reported segment revenue includes allocable other income and internal sales. The rows are before the internal-sales deduction; this is not external-customer sales alone.
definition: Reported segment profit before interest and tax, before unallocated finance charges and expenses, equity-accounted joint-venture results and tax/regulatory-deferral tax adjustments. It is not profit after tax.
location: PDF page19 · Statement of Consolidated Segment-wise Revenue, Results, Assets and Liabilities
notes: Audited full-year March 31, 2026 column. Already ₹ crore. Gross segment income ₹47,625.17 crore less ₹419.23 crore internal revenue plus ₹478.49 crore other unallocated income gives ₹47,684.43 crore total income. Segment PBIT ₹27,322.50 crore includes depreciation but not common unallocated expenses or finance charges. After joint-venture losses, unallocated income, finance/common costs and tax/regulatory-deferral tax adjustments, group PAT is ₹15,927.95 crore. Do not compare segment PBIT with net profit as if they were the same measure.
insight: Transmission generates most segment income and earnings. Telecom earns a larger reported segment result than consultancy despite lower segment income; common financing and corporate costs still have to be considered.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment income before internal-sales deduction
